ai_result.long_description:
Keep everyday essentials close with this handmade black leather belt pouch by Alex Polak. Designed for practical everyday carry, it is a compact way to carry money, bank cards, keys and other small items while remaining discreet on the waist belt.

The pouch is made from high-quality Italian vegetable-tanned leather and completely hand-stitched with waxed thread. It can accommodate up to ten bank cards along with a certain amount of banknotes, making it a useful choice for daily errands, travel and everyday organization.

Dimensions:
- Height: 2.75 inches (70 mm)
- Width: 4.33 inches (110 mm)
- Depth: 0.79 inches (20 mm)

The pouch fits standard belts up to 1.57 inches wide (up to 40 mm).

A practical handmade gift for a father, brother, friend or anyone who appreciates durable leather EDC accessories.
